title: iLearn-Lab/NeurIPS25-CogVLA
summary: CogVLA is a NeurIPS 2025 vision-language-action model that aligns robot control with cognitive structure by routing instructions through specialized pathways and sparsifying the resulting computation. The repository appears to contain the implementation for studying how instruction-driven routing can make VLA policies more selective and efficient, rather than treating every command with the same dense model pathway.

title: MINT-SJTU/VLA-Pruner
summary: VLA-Pruner is an official implementation of a temporal-aware dual-level visual token pruning method for speeding up vision-language-action inference. It targets VLA models by pruning visual tokens with awareness of temporal structure, aiming to reduce inference cost while preserving action-relevant visual information.

extra.full_text: The official implementation of VLA-Pruner: Temporal-Aware Dual-Level Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference.

title: isaac-sim/IsaacLab-Arena
summary: Isaac Lab Arena extends NVIDIA Isaac Lab with composable tools for assembling simulation environments from interchangeable robots, objects, and scenes. It supports rapid prototyping of robotic tasks and scalable evaluation of learned policies across diverse embodiments and environment configurations.

extra.full_text: Isaac Lab - Arena is a robotics simulation framework that enhances NVIDIA Isaac Lab by providing a composable, scalable system for creating diverse simulation environments and evaluating robot learning policies. The framework enables developers to rapidly prototype and test robotic tasks with various robot embodiments, objects, and environments.
